description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Xin Zhao''' empowers his next three [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-attack icon.svg|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Attacking|An icon representing the keyword On-attack]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Attacking|on-attack]] within 5 seconds to each have an [[File:Relentless Force 2.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|An icon representing the keyword Uncancellable windup]] [[:Basic attack#Uncancellable Windup|uncancellable windup]], deal '''bonus''' physical damage and reduce his other [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|abilities']] '''current''' cooldowns by 1 second. Each attack refreshes the duration.
description.text: Active: Xin Zhao empowers his next three basic attacks on-attack within 5 seconds to each have an uncancellable windup, deal bonus physical damage and reduce his other abilities' current cooldowns by 1 second. Each attack refreshes the duration.

description2.raw: The third attack [[File:Airborne icon.png|20px|link=Airborne|An icon representing the keyword Airborne]] [[:Airborne|knocks up]] the target for 0.75 seconds.
description2.text: The third attack knocks up the target for 0.75 seconds.

description3.raw: ''Three Talon Strike's'' '''bonus''' damage is affected by [[File:Critical strike icon.png|20px|link=Critical strike|An icon representing the keyword Critical strike]] [[:Critical strike|critical strike]] modifiers.
description3.text: Three Talon Strike's bonus damage is affected by critical strike modifiers.

description4.raw: ''Three Talon Strike [[File:Bladework.png|20px|link=Basic attack#Attack reset|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack reset]] [[:Basic attack#Attack reset|resets]] '''Xin Zhao's''' basic attack timer.''
description4.text: Three Talon Strike resets Xin Zhao's basic attack timer.

notes.raw: * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will only block the knock up. * The enhanced attacks present input buffering during their wind-up animation ('''Xin Zhao''' cannot be issued any commands until after it ends). * The attack counter displayed on '''Xin Zhao's''' status bar is incremented on-hit.(bug)
